defs.def: having everything that is necessary; complete and without faults or weaknesses 完备的；完美的；完全的

ex.s: The story begins in the last years of the 18th century in Scotland, where Watt perfected "the machine that changed the world".
ex.t: 故事始于18世纪末的苏格兰，Watt在那里完善了"改变世界的机器"。

ex.s: Edison perfected an incandescent bulls that brought electric light into the American home.
ex.t: 爱迪生完善了白炽灯泡，把电灯带进了美国家庭。

ex.s: I bought a handful of perfectly ripe small strawberries and a little sweet melon.
ex.t: 我买了一小把熟透的小草莓和一个甜甜的小甜瓜。

ex.s: It works perfectly.
ex.t: 效果非常好。

ex.s: We understood one another perfectly.
ex.t: 每个人都知道规则。

ex.s: Significantly, all Harbour Air routes last less than 30 minutes, making it perfectly fit for electric engines.
ex.t: 值得注意的是，所有港湾航空的航线时长都不到30分钟，这使其非常适合使用电动发动机。

ex.s: These terraces also provide a perfect environment for birds and fish.
ex.t: 这些梯田也为鸟类和鱼类提供了一个完美的环境。

ex.s: She’s taught how to behave perfectly.
ex.t: 她被教导如何举止得体。

ex.s: The man who wrote these letters is one of the most famous names in English literature-J.R.R Tolkien, author of The Lord of the Rings That is why Letters from Father Christmas could be the perfect book...
ex.t: 写这些信的人是英国文学中最著名的名字之一——J.R.R.托尔金，《指环王》的作者。这就是为什么《来自圣诞老人的信》可能是完美的书……

ex.s: The shape creates a perfect market where goods could be shipped and received using the river as a highway.
ex.t: 这一地形造就了一个完美的市场，货物可以借河流这条“高速公路”运进运出。

ex.s: 37     Our building even had a tiny lift with a female voice that said, “Ouverture des portes,” in perfect French.
ex.t: 37 我们的大楼甚至有一部小小的电梯，里面有个女声用完美的法语说“开门”。

ex.s: As the summer months roll in, our Georgian country estate makes the perfect setting for an outdoor fitness session.
ex.t: 来吧，在我们的合格私人教练乔迪·麦格雷戈的带领下，在米德尔顿庄园的场地上锻炼。

ex.s: She was extremely pretty, and her house was a reflection of   61   （she）, everything in good taste and in perfect order.
ex.t: 她极其漂亮，她的房子是___61___（她）的写照，一切都很有品位、井井有条。

ex.s: Then one perfect Amazonian evening, with monkeys calling from beyond the village green, we played soccer.
ex.t: 后来在一个完美的亚马孙夜晚，村庄绿地那头猴子鸣叫，我们踢起了足球。

ex.s: It’s jaw-dropping how much perfectly good food is thrown away — from “ugly” (but quite eatable) vegetables rejected by grocers to large amounts of uneaten dishes thrown into restaurant garbage cans.
ex.t: 完美完好的食物被扔掉的数量令人震惊——从杂货商拒绝的"丑陋"（但完全可以食用）的蔬菜到大量被扔进餐厅垃圾桶的剩菜。

ex.s: Though they are useful for detecting shifts in the number and variety of species in an area, a new Stanford study has found that this type of record is not perfect.
ex.t: 尽管它们有助于发现一个地区物种数量和种类的变化，斯坦福的一项新研究发现这类记录并不完美。

ex.s: The color she choose came in a box which had a picture of a woman that hair color looked just perfect.
ex.t: 她选的颜色装在一个盒子里，盒子上有一个女人的图片，那发色看起来恰到好处。

ex.s: When I was rejected from one that had seemed like a perfect fit, it was undoubtedly difficult.
ex.t: 当我被一个看似完美契合的职位拒绝时，无疑很难受。

ex.s: Rather than setting plans in stone, I’ve learned that sometimes I need to take the opportunities that are offered, even if they don’t sound perfect at the time, and make the most of them.
ex.t: 与其把计划定死，我学到了有时候我需要抓住提供的机会，即使当时听起来并不完美，并且充分利用它们。

ex.s: The next technique is to write your draft rapidly without worrying about being perfect.
ex.t: 下一个技巧是快速写草稿，不必担心完美。

ex.s: Her desire to be perfect.
ex.t: 她追求完美的愿望。

ex.s: creating a perfect world for patients
ex.t: 为患者创造一个完美的世界

ex.s: Your goal is not to be a perfect public speaker.
ex.t: 你的目标不是成为完美的公开演讲者。

ex.s: Making yourself a Perfect Chef
ex.t: 让自己成为完美大厨

ex.s: Expert gardeners know just the right corner for roses, and others spend hours trying to grow perfect vegetables to enter into competitions.
ex.t: 专业园丁最清楚玫瑰适合种在哪个角落，而其他人则花上好几个小时试图种出完美的蔬菜去参加比赛。

ex.s: My perfectionist tendencies were the main root of this: I wanted to be perfect at whatever I did, which obviously in life is not possible, but it consumed me.
ex.t: 我的完美主义倾向是主要原因：我想在所做的任何事情上都做到完美，这在生活中显然是不可能的，但它吞噬了我。

ex.s: I believe this was a perfect   29   for a child in losing something important…to lose it and feel the full   30   of that loss, and then to miraculously get it back.
ex.t: 我相信，对于一个孩子来说，这是失去重要之物的完美___29___……失去它，感受那份失去的全部___30___，然后奇迹般地失而复得。

ex.s: Morning or Afternoon, this bike tour is the perfect tour for D.C. newcomers and locals looking to experience Washington, D.C. in a healthy way with minimum effort.
ex.t: 无论上午或下午，这次骑行游都是华盛顿新来者和当地居民以最省力、健康的方式体验华盛顿特区的完美之选。

defs.def: completely correct; exact and accurate 完全正确的；准确的；地道的

ex.s: “it seemed like the perfect chance for natural selection to act on a population," said Dr Ilardo.
ex.t: “这似乎是自然选择作用于一个种群的绝佳机会，”伊拉尔多博士说。

defs.def: the best of its kind 优秀的；最佳的
excellent; very good 极好的；很好的
exactly right for sb/sth 对 … 正合适的

ex.s: If you’re willing to drive a little further, the Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles promises luxurious rooms and extensive leisure facilities — perfect for turning a game day into a great weekend escape.
ex.t: 如果你愿意开得稍远一点，洛杉矶丽思卡尔顿酒店承诺提供豪华客房和丰富的休闲设施——非常适合把比赛日变成一次很棒的周末出游。

ex.s: It had simple words and colorful pictures—a perfect match for his age.
ex.t: 它有简单的文字和彩色的图画——正适合他的年龄。

defs.def: total; complete 全部的；完全的；纯然的

connected with the form of a verb that consists of part of the verb have with the past participle of the main verb, used to express actions completed by the present or a particular point in the past or future （动词）完成时的，完成式的
